extraction_notes: Despite the 1SS389 signal-diode style part number, the datasheet titles the part a Surface Mount Schottky Barrier Rectifier (SOD-523, VR = 10 V, IF(AV) per page 1 features 0.1 A, maximum ratings table 0.2 A); variant is recorded as schottky.

Curves were digitized from the embedded PDF vector paths, not from raster pixel reading. Fig. 1/2/3 grid lines gave axis anchors (Fig. 1: 0-500 mV linear, 0.1-100 mA log; Fig. 2: 0-10 V linear, 0.1-1000 uA log; Fig. 3: 0-10 V linear, 0-50 pF linear); bezier curve segments were sampled and interpolated at round abscissa values.

Digitized curves are self-consistent with the limit table: Fig. 1 25 degC gives VF about 0.375 V at 100 mA (max 0.5 V) and 0.274 V at 5 mA (max 0.3 V); Fig. 2 25 degC gives IR about 0.64 uA at 10 V (max 20 uA); Fig. 3 gives CT about 37 pF near VR = 0 (max 40 pF).

Inconsistency noted: the table lists typical VF = 0.18 V at IF = 1.0 mA, but the digitized Fig. 1 Ta = 25 degC curve reads about 0.229 V at 1.0 mA. Both values are recorded with their sources; fitting should prefer the multi-point curve and treat the single 0.18 V table point with caution.
The Fig. 1 Ta = 25 degC vector path spans 0.104 mA to 98.7 mA; endpoint points use the true path extremes rather than extrapolated decade values.
breakdown_current records the specified V(BR) test current (IR = 100 uA); it is a test condition of the minimum-breakdown row, not an independently measured min/typ/max quantity.

Absolute maximum ratings on p. 1 (VRRM = 10 V, VRMS = 7 V, VDC = 10 V, IF(AV) = 0.2 A, IFSM = 1.0 A at 8.3 ms half-sine, PD = 150 mW, Tj = -40 to +125 degC, RthJA = 667 degC/W) are operating-region evidence only and were not fitted.
Fig. 4 is a power derating curve, not a diode IV characteristic, and was not digitized.
The supplied PDF identifies Zhuhai Hongjiacheng Technology co., Ltd; the top-level manufacturer preserves the exact job identity hongjiacheng.
extraction.omission_reason: The datasheet publishes no reverse-recovery time; reverse_recovery remains null.
